_help: Edit these to change the About page. To override without rebuilding, put a copy of this file named about.json next to HyperwaveSensors.exe. Leave a link empty ("") to hide its button.
name: TaiiRepublic
about: Hi, I'm Taii — a small streamer who built Hyperwave Sensors as an analytics program to track my stream info in a way that was easy to read. Bot and viewbot scanning came after, and then I decided to open it up for everyone. If it helps your stream too, swing by my Twitch channel, say hi, and jump into the fun. o7
